summary: Valenzuela 1st District representative with 226 principal-authored bills. Authored rights and welfare protections for online freelancers, regulation of debt collection to protect debtors, a tax amnesty, several National Internal Revenue Code amendments and a bill strengthening the right to information.
caveat: Direction of the three NIRC amendments was not reviewed. Right to information is a single institutions issue and unscored. Only 7 rubric bills surfaced from 226.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored freelancer protections (-2) and debtor protection against abusive collection (-2), offset by a general tax amnesty on unpaid taxes (+1). NIRC amendments unreviewed.
